Chapter 722: Chapter 19 Major Gains (Please Subscribe)

In fact, it’s not entirely accurate to call it a Supreme Weapon.

But at the very least, it is a Twelve-Star Level Rare Treasure.

Only entities that transcend the Eleven-Stars can withstand the rules of the Two-dimensional World.

“Has this bronze compass been in this two-dimensional world for a very long time, a relic that was lost here from the past?”

Lin Yuan speculated.

The two-dimensional world he was currently in was essentially a piece of ‘White Paper’ that had been ejected from the Taiyuan Relic, far beyond the universe.

...

After traversing the vast distances through the Chaos Void, it ultimately squeezed into the universe of human civilization.

It was unknown through what places this sheet of ‘White Paper’ had passed, such as inhaling lives like Lin Yuan, how many powerhouses, and treasures it had absorbed.

But one thing was certain.

Only Twelfth Rank lives that have stepped out of the River of Time could rid themselves of becoming two-dimensional.

As for the treasures and Rare Weapons at the Twelfth Rank Level? Without a master in control, once they fully fall into the two-dimensional world, they might end up like the current bronze compass, its divine power unrevealed, merely with a faint mysterious aura circulating.

Even the Supreme Beings, if they did not resist and allowed themselves to be absorbed into the two-dimensional world by the ‘White Paper’, would probably have their strengths suppressed substantially.

“This bronze compass? A Twelve-Star Strange Treasure? Or even a Supreme Weapon?” Lin Yuan found it hard to believe.

In the Main World, how precious Twelve-Star Strange Treasures are, especially Supreme Weapons, which are the foundation of Peak Clans.

Wielding a Supreme Weapon, one could unleash attacks at the Supreme Level. The Eternal Spatial Rifts in the small and medium-sized Battlefields of Different Races were created in this manner.

So far, the only chance Lin Yuan had to come into contact with a Twelve-Star Rare Treasure weapon was through passing the fifth floor of the Demonic Jade Space Black Tower.

Lin Yuan, who had reached the Ninth Rank and thoroughly understood the Rule of Time, was rewarded with a selection of Twelve-Star Treasures upon passing the fifth floor of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan could choose one from among them.

Even so, Lin Yuan hadn’t made his decision up to now because the opportunity was too precious.

And now.

A bronze compass, which was highly likely to be a Supreme Weapon, just appeared so easily before him?

Lin Yuan believed this bronze compass was most likely a Supreme Weapon because it was clearly not naturally formed.

It obviously had been refined later, otherwise, it wouldn’t have such a distinct shape as a compass.

And a Supreme Weapon is often refined from several, or even dozens, of twelve-star treasures.

“If I can leave this world smoothly, can’t I take this bronze compass with me?” Lin Yuan’s heart pounded with excitement.

This was a weapon of Twelve-Star Level Rare Treasures, right? In the two-dimensional world, it was ordinary, merely with a faint mysterious aura circulating.

But once it left the two-dimensional world and appeared in the Main Universe, it would be a weapon of infinite divine power.

In the Main Universe, because of that Cosmic Aurora, the Supreme Beings of human civilization and other Peak Clans nearly came to blows.

One could imagine how precious treasures of this level were.

“Not just this bronze compass, the Blood Rain Tea Tree from the Xueyu Ancient Country should also be a Twelve-Star Treasure.”

Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

Merely some tea leaves could possess a slight mysterious aura; the Blood Rain Tea Tree, as the parent body, must be no less significant than the bronze compass.

“Do the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses know about this?”

Lin Yuan wondered to himself, at least he hadn’t heard of it from Nalan.

In fact, Lin Yuan’s acquisition of this bronze compass was a very coincidental event. If the powerhouses of the Myriad Clans had similar encounters, they would surely keep it secret.

As for the national treasures of the Ancient Countries, such as the Blood Rain Tea Tree from the Xueyu Ancient Country… so far, the strongest among the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses was the Witch Emperor, with none stepping into the realm of the Witch Ancestor yet.

Under these circumstances, it was impossible to directly challenge the authority of the Ancient Countries.

But Lin Yuan speculated that day would not be far off.

As time passed, there would be a large number of powerhouses from the Myriad Clans becoming Witch Ancestors.

Even those at Tier 11, through their mastery of power, could force their way well beyond the Witch Ancestor.

By then, treasures like the bronze compass would definitely not be able to be kept secret.

…

“In this two-dimensional world, there should be a considerable number of similar Twelve-Star Treasures,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Just the twelve Ancient Countries alone each had their own national treasures, not to mention those scattered about, like the bronze compass in Lin Yuan’s possession.

“Forget it.”

“At least I’ve obtained one for now.”

Lin Yuan didn’t have much interest in other Twelve-Star Treasures.

At the moment, his attention was entirely focused on the bronze compass before him.

“Does using this compass require blood?” Lin Yuan pondered. When he first discovered the compass, he had noticed blood stains on it.

“Let’s try.”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and squeezed out over a dozen drops of blood, letting them fall onto the compass.

Hum hum hum.

At the same time.

The copper needle suspended in the center of the compass began to spin rapidly.

Soon.

“`

The copper needle stopped.

An information suddenly appeared in Lin Yuan’s mind.

“No dangers have been detected so far.”

“Detect dangers?” Lin Yuan pondered in his heart, “Can this compass capture the dangers that are about to come, and then point out a way to survive?”

The conclusion that Lin Yuan drew was not solely based on the information transmitted by the compass itself.

It was also based on the past performance of the Yunshan Eighteen Thieves.

Outsiders believed that the Yunshan Eighteen Thieves had an astonishing intuition.

They could often leave in advance before the arrival of overwhelming powerhouses.

Lin Yuan used to think this was the intuition of the Yunshan Eighteen Thieves.

But now, seeing this bronze compass, it must be that the intuition of the Yunshan Eighteen Thieves came from this compass.

“It’s a good thing, indeed.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Although the use of the bronze compass was not that of those direct combat power-enhancing lethal weapons.

But detecting dangers in advance was certainly a rare ability.

The most important point was.

This ability basically matched the main goals that Lin Yuan had set after landing in this two-dimensional world.

Lin Yuan possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding; his limit in this world was far beyond those of Tier 11 lives.

Given time, Lin Yuan would sooner or later sweep through this two-dimensional world.

Before that, the ability to detect dangers in advance and strive for growth time was crucial.

“This compass should be a premonitory-type exotic treasure and weapon.”

Lin Yuan thought silently, the premonition of impending dangers was just the ability of the compass suppressed by the two-dimensional world.

If it escaped the two-dimensional world, the full potential of the bronze compass would likely involve various premonitions of future timelines.

Such treasures, not even within human civilization or the Main Universe, had Lin Yuan heard of.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and the Demon Jade Space, they were well-known.

Starting from Tier 12, the goal of ultimate beings was to transform into Perfect Time Beings.

And Perfect Time Beings, existing in the past, present, and future, could easily see each timeline’s beginning and end if they so desired.

This type of premonitory exotic treasure and weapon was a product that replicated the minor abilities of Perfect Time Beings.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, five years had gone by.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his body surging with vital energy like an ocean, the temperature around him soaring so rapidly that even ordinary Witch King level powerhouses couldn’t come close.

“After spending five years, I have finally devised a Witch Emperor-level cultivation method and successfully advanced to the Witch Emperor tier.” Lin Yuan reined in his aura, nodding in satisfaction, “With my Against-Heaven’s Understanding to deduce and enlighten the Dao, the Witch Emperor-level cultivation method I’ve created is superior to all Witch Emperors in this world.”

In simple terms, Lin Yuan was now a Witch Emperor, but he was already invincible at that tier, and even those Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses and Eleventh Rank Peak lives that fell into this world, as long as they were within the Witch Emperor’s domain, couldn’t defeat Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan had stayed in the Witch King realm for more than a decade and had only recently advanced to the Witch Emperor tier, nearly exhausting every bit of potential at the Witch King level.

“However, to create my own Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skill, it would be best to review the Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skills compiled by the Twelve Ancient Countries.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Each of the founders of the twelve ancient countries in this world was an Ancestor Witch, and the Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skills they passed down were the foundation of the royal families of the great ancient countries.

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even without those Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skills for reference, he could create his own Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skill.

But it would undoubtedly take much longer.

Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skills were essentially the Ancestor Witches’ exploration and enlightenment of the essence of the world.

Lin Yuan reviewing those Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skills was akin to standing on the shoulders of past giants, greatly benefiting the creation of his own Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skill.

It would at least save a lot of time.

“Currently, my power rivals the Unconquered Witch King and is comparable to an Ancestor Witch,” Lin Yuan made a clear assessment of himself.

Purely in terms of combat power, he was no weaker than any Ancestor Witch of ancient and modern times.

Of course, here, the term Ancestor Witch refers to native Ancestor Witches and doesn’t include those powerhouses from Myriad Tribes.

Some special Eleventh Rank Peak lives in the Main Universe, once they become Ancestor Witches, leveraging their mastery of power, are definitely much stronger than those native Ancestor Witches of the past.

But for those special Eleventh Rank Peak lives, once they step into the Ancestor Witch tier, their cultivation speed plummets, as there is no path forward.

“Now, quite a few Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses have successively become Ancestor Witches,” Lin Yuan thought of the information he had learned over the years.

The cultivation paths of those Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses completely follow this world’s cultivation system, so their speed is extremely fast, and there are no bottlenecks, as the realm of their true bodies sets the stage.

Lin Yuan’s understanding was too profound; he ventured on his own path at the Witch King tier and even created his unique Witch Emperor’s cultivation method, so in terms of pure cultivation speed, he definitely couldn’t compare with those Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

However, Lin Yuan was not worried at all, now as a Witch Emperor he matched an Ancestor Witch, and once he stepped into the Ancestor Witch tier, he might directly rival the few strongest Eleventh Rank lives.

In the Main Universe, Lin Yuan’s strength was far from matching any of those Eleventh Rank Peak lives; the gap between them was as vast as a chasm.

But this two-dimensional world seemed tailor-made for Lin Yuan,

Provided enough time, those Eleventh Rank Peak lives couldn’t catch up to Lin Yuan, even if they tried.
